parsed.post: New personal best! Testing DEPTH=6 with MATRIX_LR=0.05 and WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 yielded 1.005001. Since the previous best was 1.015525, I'm keeping this. Next, I'll try a slightly more aggressive learning rate (0.07) to see if we can push past 1.00.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.07 to see if faster convergence can lower val_bpb further, while maintaining DEPTH=6 and WARMUP_RATIO=0.05.
